title: FedRAMP AI Agent Compliance Manifest
description: Canonical compliance manifest schema for AI agents deployed within or operating on FedRAMP Class C and Class D Cloud Service Offerings under FedRAMP Consolidated Rules 2026 (CR-26, version 2026.11.02.01) and CoSAI Risk Map architectural boundaries.

agent_id.description: Unique lowercase kebab-case slug identifier for the agent.

version.description: Semantic version string of the agent release.

team.description: Engineering or platform team owning the agent.

responsible_official.description: Named accountable official responsible for agent compliance (CPO-CSO-OVR / SDR-CSO-FRR).

service_class.description: FedRAMP Service Class ('C' for Moderate/Class C, 'D' for High/Class D).

certification_tracks.description: Active or target FedRAMP certification tracks ('20x', 'Rev5').

cso_package_id.description: FedRAMP Marketplace CSO Package ID (e.g., FR2628650874 or F1603047866).

in_minimum_assessment_scope.description: Whether the agent is included in the Minimum Assessment Scope (MAS-CSO-IIR / MAS-CSO-MDI / MAS-CSO-SUP).

agent_profile.description: Deployment profile: 'runtime-cso' (in-boundary handling Federal Customer Data/metadata) or 'internal-devsecops' (internal engineering/platform/compliance agent operating on the CSO).

handles_federal_customer_data.description: Whether the agent ingests, processes, stores, or transmits Federal Customer Data (FRD-FCD / MAS-CSO-IIR).

handles_sensitive_metadata.description: Whether the agent handles privileged or sensitive system metadata (FRD-MTD / MAS-CSO-MDI).

residency_boundary.description: Data and inference processing residency boundary (e.g., 'US-GovCloud / US Jurisdiction Only' per CTL.SA.SA-09-05 for Class D).

inference_provider.description: Description of the model serving substrate or authorized inference destination.

fedramp_certified_tpir_id.description: FedRAMP Package ID of the certified Third-Party Information Resource hosting inference, or null if self-hosted inside the CSO boundary.

model_reachability_pep.description: Whether a dedicated Model Serving Policy Enforcement Point (CoSAI componentModelServing / ADR-030) enforces reachability and egress rules.

us_jurisdiction_only.description: Whether all inference processing, weights, caches, and system services remain exclusively within U.S. / U.S. Territories / U.S. jurisdiction (mandatory true for Class D under CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

fips_140_3_validated_modules.description: Whether all cryptographic modules protecting Federal data/sessions are active FIPS-validated modules (CMU-CSO-UVM: SHOULD for Class C, MUST for Class D).

module_id.description: CMVP certificate number or module identifier (CMU-CSO-CMD).

validation_status.description: Validation status (e.g., 'FIPS 140-3 Active', 'FIPS 140-2 Active per Transition', 'SDR Documented Rationale').

purpose.description: Security boundary or transport/storage layer protected by this module.

digital_identity_level.description: NIST SP 800-63-4 digital identity assurance levels (CTL.IA.IA-05: Class C requires at least IAL2/AAL2/FAL2; Class D requires IAL3/AAL3/FAL3).

encrypted_assertions.description: Whether identity assertions are encrypted end-to-end (JWE for OIDC or XML Encryption for SAML per CTL.IA.IA-05).

local_password_bypass_disabled.description: Whether local password authentication bypass is disabled for agency tenants (KSI-IAM-MFA / KSI-IAM-SFA).

delegation_model.description: Principal authority delegation and confused-deputy prevention model (e.g., RFC 8693 OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange with audience-scoped short-lived tokens).

network_egress_pep.description: Whether a dedicated Network Policy Enforcement Point governs agent and tool egress (CoSAI componentAgentNetworkPolicyEnforcementPoint / componentToolNetworkPolicyEnforcementPoint).

authorization_pep.description: Whether a dedicated Authorization Policy Enforcement Point validates every tool invocation against principal scope (CoSAI componentAuthorizationPolicyEnforcementPoint).

tool_registry_allowlist.description: Whether tool discovery and invocation are restricted to a cryptographically pinned allowlist (CoSAI componentToolRegistry / controlToolRegistryAndDiscoveryIntegrity).

third_party_tool_isolation.description: Whether external/third-party tools execute inside an isolated sandbox runtime (CoSAI componentIsolationRuntime / componentToolHosting).

consent_surface_dual_mode.description: Whether dual consent surfaces (application-level and agent-level per CoSAI componentApplicationConsentSurface / componentAgentConsentSurface) gate destructive or external mutations.

allowed_tools.description: Explicit inventory of allowlisted tool identifiers.

tamper_evident_audit_repo.description: Whether agent invocations, tool calls, and policy decisions are written to a tamper-evident audit repository (CoSAI componentAuditRecordRepository / KSI-MLA-ALA / CTL.AU.AU-09).

prompt_response_redacted_from_external_t.description: Whether raw prompts, responses, and Federal Customer Data are scrubbed/redacted prior to any external telemetry sink (MAS-CSO-MDI / controlRuntimePrivacyEnhancingTechnologies).

audit_control_plane_separated.description: Whether the audit record repository resides in a separate control plane inaccessible to the agent runtime workload.

tpirs.description: Inventory of Third-Party Information Resources (TPIRs) leveraged by the agent (MAS-CSO-TPR).

certified.description: Whether the TPIR holds an active FedRAMP Certification at or above the agent's service class.

fedramp_package_id.description: FedRAMP Marketplace Package ID when certified is true; null when certified is false.

use_case.description: Architectural purpose and data flow description for the TPIR.

mitigations.description: Mandatory boundary protections, data redaction, and compensating controls (MAS-CSO-TPR).

vdr_triage_sla_days.description: Maximum days to evaluate and triage newly detected vulnerabilities (VER-TFR-EVU: <= 5 days for Class C, <= 2 days for Class D).

scn_change_channel.description: Controlled distribution channel or URI for Significant Change Notifications (SCN-ADP-NTF / SCN-CSO-INF).

iec_incident_channel.description: Incident escalation and notification channel for FedRAMP and agency customers (IEC-CSO-IIR / IEC-CSO-OIR / IEC-CSO-FIR).

per_service_certification_artifacts.description: Whether per-service FedRAMP Certification materials are maintained and supplied (CDS-CSO-PSM: MAY for Class C, MUST for Class D).

portable_eval_paths.description: Relative repository paths to portable, vendor-neutral evaluation suites (CoSAI ADR-033 D6).

cosai_component_ids.description: CoSAI Risk Map component IDs in scope for this agent (e.g., componentModelServing, componentIsolationRuntime).

cosai_control_ids.description: CoSAI Risk Map control IDs implemented by this agent (e.g., controlAgentCredentialIsolation, controlAgentExecutionBounds).
